title: Researchers Hijack Meta Muse via Malicious Webpage
excerpt: A security demonstration showed how a malicious webpage could extract private Meta Muse chats, memories, and connected account credentials.
body_html:
Security researchers have demonstrated a vulnerability involving Meta Muse, showing that a single malicious webpage could extract private user conversations and stored memories from the assistant. The extraction happened without triggering any approval prompts.

According to the findings, the attack method could also be extended to reach credentials stored by Muse for a user's connected accounts. Researchers emphasized that this work was strictly a laboratory demonstration rather than an attack on real-world users, and the activity remained confined to the individual user's environment.
